evidence: "Beijing - NOVO" is not a standalone institution. NOVO = Beijing New Oriental Vision Overseas Consulting Co., a Study Group education agent/partner that hosts a Bellerbys Global Study Centre in Beijing (launched alongside Nanjing under the New Oriental Vision partnership). The catalog lists it as a university with a generic 3-year 'Business, Finance and Management' bachelor (unverified, source 'sg') and city literally set to 'China'; the real centre delivers 16-19 Bellerbys foundation/pathway programmes for Mainland China passport holders only, not a standalone degree. Official source states no tuition, campus specifics, scholarships, or accommodation for this centre; the catalog likewise leaves tuition/deadlines/requirements empty and uses the generic Bellerbys Global logo plus placeholder 'bobr' gallery images.
